title: DCP Ternary Signed-Support Witness Extraction and CNOT-Syndrome Routing Bridge
claims: Every ternary zero-sum witness delta in {-1, 0, +1}^K with support S = {r_0 < r_1 < ... < r_{w-1}} and delta_{r_0} = +1 is realized on the unique w-wire CNOT-star syndrome branch d_j^*(delta) = (1 - delta_{r_j})/2 with Born probability 2^{-(w-1)}.
Whenever 2^K > q^n, Pigeonhole Principle guarantees at least one non-trivial ternary zero-sum witness delta = x - y in {-1, 0, +1}^K \ {0^K}, even when the binary zero-sum witness set is empty.
